description: PostgreSQL 18 GIN and GiST text-search indexes, expression backfill, query shapes, and update maintenance
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_search_gin (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL, search TSVECTOR NOT NULL);

INSERT INTO type_matrix_search_gin VALUES ('a', 'fat cat sat', to_tsvector('english', 'fat cat sat')), ('b', 'dog chased cats', to_tsvector('english', 'dog chased cats')), ('c', 'quiet bird', to_tsvector('english', 'quiet bird'));
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_search_gin_idx ON type_matrix_search_gin USING GIN (search);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gin WHERE search @@ to_tsquery('english', 'cat:*') ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gin WHERE search @@ to_tsquery('english', 'dog | bird') ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gin WHERE search @@ phraseto_tsquery('english', 'fat cat') ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gin WHERE search @@ to_tsquery('english', 'cat & !dog') ORDER BY id;
UPDATE type_matrix_search_gin SET body = 'new phrase', search = to_tsvector('english', 'new phrase') WHERE id = 'a';
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gin WHERE search @@ to_tsquery('english', 'new') ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_search_gist (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_search_gist_idx ON type_matrix_search_gist USING GIST (to_tsvector('simple', body));
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gist WHERE to_tsvector('simple', body) @@ to_tsquery('simple', 'alpha') ORDER BY id;
UPDATE type_matrix_search_gist SET body = 'delta epsilon' WHERE id = 'g1';
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_search_gist WHERE to_tsvector('simple', body) @@ to_tsquery('simple', 'delta') ORDER BY id;
